eyebrow: The System · Interactive Circle of Nine
heading: Journey Through the Nine Functions
intro: Every person, relationship, and organization runs on nine connected functions. Click any point on the circle to fractal in, explore its explanation, and open its interactive story.
notice_body: The Circle of Nine flows clockwise from Vision (01) through Contribution (05) to Renewal (09). Select any function to dive inside it.
closing: Want to see where these nine functions are flowing smoothly—or getting in the way—in your life or business right now?

tiles.name: Strategy
tiles.question: What Future Is Waiting for You to Create?
tiles.summary: You have the potential to imagine a future that doesn't exist yet—and begin creating it.
tiles.explanation: Your vision gives direction to your choices, inspires others, and turns meaningful goals into reality. When this function is dormant, busy days keep repeating yesterday; when awakened, you begin choosing where your life, family, and organization are actually going.
tiles.scales_note: Expresses as leading your own life, creating a shared family future, or giving an organization clear direction.

tiles.name: Relationships
tiles.question: What Makes You Feel Truly Connected?
tiles.summary: You have the potential to understand others, build trust, and create relationships where people feel heard, valued, and willing to work together.
tiles.explanation: This potential develops as you recognize how differently people think, communicate, and respond. When used consciously, differences become opportunities for understanding rather than silent friction between people who care.
tiles.scales_note: Expresses as self-understanding, deeper family trust, and collaborative alignment across teams.

tiles.name: Analysis & Systems
tiles.question: What Happens When You See Only Part of the Picture?
tiles.summary: You have the potential to understand how different elements connect, recognize patterns and consequences, and build a coherent framework for decisions and action.
tiles.explanation: Everyone holds a piece of the truth, yet scattered viewpoints rarely reveal the whole system. Seeing how pieces fit together prevents costly blind spots and turns fragmented opinions into structured clarity.
tiles.scales_note: Expresses as seeing your own direction clearly, navigating shared household decisions, or uniting business perspectives.

tiles.name: Knowledge & Priorities
tiles.question: When Everything Seems Important, What Do You Choose?
tiles.summary: You have the potential to recognize what matters, discover new possibilities, and choose where to direct your attention and energy.
tiles.explanation: As this potential develops, you learn to distinguish genuinely useful information from noisy distractions, spot opportunities that support your true goals, and adjust priorities calmly when circumstances shift.
tiles.scales_note: Completes the inner four foundations so outward growth rests on clarity rather than scattered effort.

tiles.name: Contribution & Expansion
tiles.question: What If Your Contribution Could Reach Further Than You Imagine?
tiles.summary: You have the potential to expand your positive influence beyond familiar boundaries—without having to control everything yourself.
tiles.explanation: Function 5 is the turning point of the nine-function system. Built on the foundation of Functions 1–4, it turns what you know and care about into wider service and shared impact without leading to exhaustion or burnout.
tiles.scales_note: Bridges personal readiness (1–4) into joyful, sustainable expression in the wider world (6–9).

tiles.name: Psychology & Fulfillment
tiles.question: What If Feeling Wonderful Wasn't a Reward, but a Way of Living?
tiles.summary: You have the potential to create a life in which beauty, comfort, nourishment, pleasure, love, and emotional satisfaction are natural parts of everyday experience.
tiles.explanation: You don't have to exhaust yourself to deserve a fulfilling life. Recognizing what genuinely nourishes your mind, body, and spirit becomes the living ground from which lasting creativity flows.
tiles.scales_note: Restores inner emotional richness so action is fueled by joy rather than mere obligation.

tiles.name: Mission & Action
tiles.question: What If the Work Could Give You Energy Instead of Taking It Away?
tiles.summary: You have the potential to discover what brings your abilities alive, see hidden connections, restore movement in difficult situations, and turn possibilities into reality.
tiles.explanation: Function 7 is the energy of realization. When your genuine interests and talents meet real-world needs, curiosity and momentum replace heaviness—and stalled situations start moving again.
tiles.scales_note: Turns inspiration and lived fulfillment into purposeful methodology and daily execution.

tiles.name: Material Results
tiles.question: What If You Could Build More Wealth Without Working Harder?
tiles.summary: You have the potential to create, organize, and sustain material prosperity without continually increasing the demands on your time, energy, and personal resources.
tiles.explanation: Wealth is more than money earned—it is what works reliably, what endures, and the freedom your systems make possible. Organizing responsibilities and resources transforms effort into lasting stability.
tiles.scales_note: Aligns people, systems, and resources so tangible results compound cleanly.

tiles.name: Completion & Renewal
tiles.question: What If Every Completion Brought You Closer to an Extraordinary Achievement?
tiles.summary: You have the potential to recognize when something has fulfilled its purpose, discover what remains valuable, and open a new chapter without carrying everything from the past.
tiles.explanation: Function 9 brings the entire system together. Rather than clinging to every finished chapter, you discern what deserves to continue, what is ready to conclude, and what can now be created next.
tiles.scales_note: Closes one cycle cleanly and feeds distilled wisdom straight back into a stronger Function 01.
